question: Which transcendent nature and martial identity are attributed to the deity Skanda?
premises: The subject is described as beyond Indra in status.
The subject possesses a manifold-form nature.
The subject is identified as Skanda, conqueror of other cities.
inference: Skanda is characterized as a transcendent deity whose nature is manifold and whose power includes martial conquest.
plain_english: He is beyond Indra, of manifold form, Skanda, the conqueror of enemy cities.
